adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `createEvent` and `createAttendees` now destructure `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then always use `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` as `calendarId` (lines shown in diff around 125-165 and 160-190). Meanwhile, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` was changed to support multiple `destinationCalendar` entries (looping over `event.destinationCalendar`) to create events for multiple collective hosts. Because the Lark service does not select the destination calendar based on the credential being used (it ignores which destination/credential is currently being processed and just takes index 0), attempts to create events for other hosts will still target the first destination calendar, causing incorrect/broken behavior for multi-host collective scenarios.
